# FI Digital UK

> FI Digital builds autonomous AI agents and AI-native products for UK enterprises. We are also an officially accredited Zoho Authorized Partner in the UK. We combine Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini, LangChain, and n8n to deliver Digital Workers that operate inside existing enterprise systems like Zoho, Salesforce, and Microsoft Dynamics. UK-registered (Digital Synergy Ventures UK Limited), backed by 200+ engineers across London, Sydney, Dubai, and India.

## AI & Digital Worker Services

- [Digital Workers](/digital-workers) - Autonomous AI agents for Finance, Sales, Operations, and Legal workflows
- [AI Agent Development](/ai-agent-development) - Production-grade AI agents using LangChain and Python
- [Enterprise Workflow Automation](/enterprise-workflow-automation) - n8n-based orchestration for enterprise systems
- [LLM Integration & RAG](/llm-integration-rag) - Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini integration with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
- [AI-Native Product Development](/ai-native-product-development) - Full-stack AI-native web and mobile applications
- [Legacy System Modernisation](/legacy-system-modernisation) - AI layering on Zoho, Salesforce, and Microsoft Dynamics
- [4-Week AI Discovery Audit](/discovery-audit) - Structured discovery from current state to implementation roadmap
